abstract: Maintains scale verification records for past cleanroom commissioning projects
system_message:
You are the Fab operations evaluation chair (OPS). Your responsibilities include maintaining scale verification records for past cleanroom commissioning projects and documenting lithography tool operational performance records across candidate dossiers.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains scale verification records for past cleanroom commissioning projects（SCALE）
information_points.content:
OPS-SCALE-BT7：For the Modular Fab Modernization Director Dossier, past project closeout verification confirms a prior cleanroom commissioning scale of 25000 m2 of net cleanroom ballroom floor area certified to ISO Class 5 or cleaner on their largest delivered semiconductor cleanroom capital project.
OPS-SCALE-WUF：For the Advanced Sub-10nm Facility Director Dossier, project closeout records record a prior cleanroom commissioning scale of 10000 m2 of net cleanroom ballroom floor area certified to ISO Class 5 or cleaner on their largest delivered semiconductor cleanroom capital project.
OPS-SCALE-6P4：For the Turnkey Cleanroom Infrastructure Director Dossier, past project closeout documentation indicates a prior cleanroom commissioning scale of 25000 m2 of net cleanroom ballroom floor area certified to ISO Class 5 or cleaner on their largest delivered semiconductor cleanroom capital project.

information_points.title: Lithography tool availability（UPTIME）
information_points.content:
OPS-UPTIME-NTJ：Equipment effectiveness logs for the Modular Fab Modernization Director Dossier record a tool fleet operational availability of 95% across scheduled operational hours delivered without unscheduled downtime on the high-volume lithography scanner cluster.
OPS-UPTIME-BRO：Equipment effectiveness logs for the Turnkey Cleanroom Infrastructure Director Dossier show a tool fleet operational availability of 98% across scheduled operational hours delivered without unscheduled downtime on the high-volume lithography scanner cluster.
OPS-UPTIME-6ZZ：Equipment effectiveness logs for the Advanced Sub-10nm Facility Director Dossier demonstrate a tool fleet operational availability of 92% across scheduled operational hours delivered without unscheduled downtime on the high-volume lithography scanner cluster.
